threadDefinition: JIT compiler threads and all other threads excluded from application denominator; all work on application threads included.
limitations: One captured replay per revision; no stability, latency fraction, speedup or acceptance conclusion.
Full-stack serialization checked against independent outer collapsed files; JFR not decoded again by this audit.
Allocation weights are sampled TLAB/outside-TLAB bytes, not exact objects or total allocated bytes.
Input versus current graph/JAR hashes independently match; completed.json separately records root pre/post checks.

rejected133SelectedTupleLoop.finding: Every selected tuple invokes selectedTupleStringIds; each non-null projected value calls findId directly, with no per-call value-ID or property membership map. Missing IDs short circuit the current tuple; successful duplicates/repeated values repeat lookup.

frozenMainRawLocalCaches.finding: selectedStringIds.getOrPut caches positive and negative value-to-ID results across selected tuples in this storage call; selectedPropertyMembership caches property-specific membership by packed property/string ID.

stringTableLookup.finding: Loaded tables have null indexMap. findId binary searches and calls list.get(middle).toString().compareTo(s), causing repeated front-coded extraction and temporary strings. Existing work accounting per selected projection field is not an exact count of internal binary-search comparisons or allocations.
